about_the_game:
Synopsis

A rhythm game woven in a world of gears and steam. Immerse yourself in a steampunk world with vocal tracks that tell stories. Though it's an unknown world, it feels somehow nostalgic. When machines and human hearts intersect, new stories are born...

Features

A low to medium difficulty rhythm game with fixed 4-lane gameplay. Features 2D/3D viewpoint switching and complete practice mode (speed adjustment and section specification available). Steam leaderboard supported. 9 basic tracks + collect items to unlock 18 additional tracks in the shop. Skin customization feature also included.

How to Play

Hit notes with perfect timing using the DFJK keys on your keyboard.

  • Tap Note = Standard note

  • Hold Note = Hold the key for the specified duration

  • Count Note = Hit the specified number of times

  • Swipe Note = Press the designated key while pressing the space key

  • Bomb Note = Explodes when the countdown progresses over time. You need to periodically stop the timer.

  • Ghost Note = Notes that should not be hit.

*The setting of this story is entirely original and has no relation to any specific incidents, persons, religions, or organizations.

  • Ending: None

  • Estimated Play Time: 8 hours

  • Controls: Keyboard + Mouse

  • Save Function: Available

Streaming Guidelines

  • Streaming and Commentary Videos • No prior contact required for streaming or creating commentary videos of the game. • Content creation is freely permitted regardless of monetization status.

  • Guidelines • Please refrain from slanderous or aggressive comments toward others. • Please treat game content and other players with respect.
